name: Zinc
short: Nausea and bad taste were more common with zinc in common-cold trials. Case reports link zinc supplements and zinc overload to copper deficiency, causing anaemia or nerve damage.
text: In a Cochrane review of randomized trials of zinc for the common cold, overall adverse events, bad taste and nausea were more common with zinc than placebo. Case reports describe copper deficiency caused by zinc supplements, including severe anaemia; a review of 55 published cases of copper deficiency myelopathy (spinal cord damage) listed zinc overload among the risk factors, and neurological recovery after copper treatment was only partial. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
